summary: Legacy abstract base class BaseDBConnection — the old-style settings-driven connection base retained for Iceberg backend inheritance. New ibis backends use the Backend protocol + IbisBackend directly, not this class.
extension_points: Abstract properties: db_abstraction_layer, provider_type, db_backend_name, settings_class
lifecycle_notes: Retained for IcebergConnectionBase inheritance — ibis backends no longer use this.
Contains commented-out SSH tunnel code — incomplete/deferred feature.
The init_ssh() method references self.ssh_required which is not defined — dead code risk.
documentation_hooks: Should be marked as legacy/internal in any docs — new backends implement the Backend protocol, not this ABC
risks: init_ssh() method references undefined self.ssh_required — will raise AttributeError if called
Mix of legacy ABC pattern and new protocol pattern creates two parallel inheritance graphs
open_questions: Should IcebergConnectionBase be refactored to drop BaseDBConnection inheritance and use the Backend protocol directly?

evidence.detail: ABC with abstract properties and commented-out SSH code
